id-20261019-news-2.title: Tax Revenue Through September 2026: Why Targets Are Hard to Reach and What It Means for State Spending

segments.src: Penerimaan pajak adalah sumber utama pembiayaan negara.
segments.tr: Tax revenue is the main source of state financing.

segments.src: Ketika belanja subsidi, perlindungan sosial, dan program prioritas pemerintah membesar, kemampuan pajak untuk tumbuh sesuai target ikut menentukan seberapa longgar ruang fiskal yang tersedia.
segments.tr: When spending on subsidies, social protection, and the government's priority programs grows, the ability of taxes to grow in line with targets also determines how much fiscal space is available.

segments.src: Menjelang akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, perhatian publik kembali tertuju pada pertanyaan yang sama: mengapa target pajak terasa berat dikejar, dan apa konsekuensinya bagi anggaran?
segments.tr: As the third quarter of 2026 draws to a close, public attention has again turned to the same question: why do tax targets feel hard to chase, and what are the consequences for the budget?

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau perpajakan. Angka realisasi resmi dapat berubah dan sebaiknya dicek pada laporan APBN KiTa dari Kementerian Keuangan serta publikasi resmi Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP).
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is informational and is not financial or tax advice. Official realization figures may change, so check the APBN KiTa reports from the Ministry of Finance and the official publications of the Directorate General of Taxes (DJP).

segments.src: ## Mengapa penerimaan pajak penting bagi APBN
segments.tr: ## Why tax revenue matters for the APBN

segments.src: Pendapatan negara dalam APBN terdiri dari penerimaan perpajakan, penerimaan negara bukan pajak (PNBP), dan hibah.
segments.tr: State revenue in the APBN consists of tax revenue, non-tax state revenue (PNBP), and grants.

segments.src: Dari ketiganya, perpajakan memiliki porsi terbesar.
segments.tr: Of these three, taxes make up the largest share.

segments.src: Artinya, setiap pergeseran dalam penerimaan pajak langsung terasa pada kemampuan pemerintah membiayai belanja tanpa menambah utang.
segments.tr: In other words, any shift in tax revenue is felt directly in the government's ability to finance spending without adding debt.

segments.src: Hubungan sederhananya begini:
segments.tr: The simple relationship is this:

segments.src: - **Penerimaan naik** memberi ruang lebih besar untuk belanja dan menekan kebutuhan pembiayaan.
segments.tr: - **Higher revenue** gives more room for spending and eases financing needs.

segments.src: - **Penerimaan tertahan** membuat defisit melebar jika belanja tetap berjalan sesuai rencana.
segments.tr: - **Revenue that falls short** widens the deficit if spending continues as planned.

segments.src: - **Belanja yang kaku**, seperti subsidi, gaji, dan transfer ke daerah, membuat penyesuaian hanya bisa dilakukan pada pos yang lebih fleksibel.
segments.tr: - **Rigid spending**, such as subsidies, salaries, and transfers to regions, means adjustments can only be made in more flexible items.

segments.src: ## Jenis pajak yang menopang dan yang melemah
segments.tr: ## Taxes that support and taxes that weaken

segments.src: Setiap jenis pajak bereaksi berbeda terhadap kondisi ekonomi.
segments.tr: Each type of tax reacts differently to economic conditions.

segments.src: Karena itu, angka total sering menyembunyikan dinamika di baliknya.
segments.tr: That is why the total figure often hides the dynamics behind it.

segments.src: ### Pajak yang cenderung menopang
segments.tr: ### Taxes that tend to support

segments.src: - **PPN dan PPnBM dalam negeri.** Pajak ini dipengaruhi konsumsi rumah tangga dan aktivitas usaha. Selama konsumsi relatif terjaga, penerimaannya cenderung lebih stabil.
segments.tr: - **Domestic VAT and luxury goods tax (PPnBM).** These are influenced by household consumption and business activity. As long as consumption holds up, their revenue tends to be more stable.

segments.src: - **PPh Pasal 21.** Pajak atas penghasilan karyawan mengikuti kondisi ketenagakerjaan dan upah. Pasar kerja yang stabil membantu penerimaannya.
segments.tr: - **Income tax Article 21 (PPh Pasal 21).** Tax on employee income follows employment and wage conditions. A stable labor market helps its revenue.

segments.src: - **Pajak atas sektor jasa dan keuangan.** Sektor yang tumbuh biasanya memberi kontribusi yang lebih konsisten.
segments.tr: - **Taxes on the services and financial sectors.** Growing sectors usually contribute more consistently.

segments.src: ### Pajak yang cenderung tertekan
segments.tr: ### Taxes that tend to be under pressure

segments.src: - **PPh Badan.** Pajak ini sangat sensitif terhadap laba perusahaan tahun sebelumnya dan terhadap harga komoditas. Ketika laba sektor tambang dan perkebunan turun, setoran ikut menyusut.
segments.tr: - **Corporate income tax (PPh Badan).** This tax is very sensitive to the previous year's corporate profits and to commodity prices. When profits in the mining and plantation sectors fall, payments shrink accordingly.

segments.src: - **PPN impor dan pajak perdagangan internasional.** Nilai dan volume impor, serta pergerakan kurs rupiah, memengaruhi hasilnya.
segments.tr: - **Import VAT and international trade taxes.** The value and volume of imports, as well as movements in the rupiah exchange rate, affect the results.

segments.src: - **Restitusi.** Pengembalian kelebihan pembayaran pajak mengurangi penerimaan neto. Restitusi yang besar membuat angka neto tampak lemah meski penerimaan bruto bergerak normal.
segments.tr: - **Tax refunds.** Refunds of overpaid taxes reduce net revenue. Large refunds make the net figure look weak even when gross revenue moves normally.

segments.src: ## Peran harga komoditas
segments.tr: ## The role of commodity prices

segments.src: Indonesia termasuk negara yang penerimaannya cukup dipengaruhi komoditas seperti batu bara, kelapa sawit, nikel, dan logam lainnya.
segments.tr: Indonesia is a country whose revenue is fairly strongly influenced by commodities such as coal, palm oil, nickel, and other metals.

segments.src: Mekanismenya tidak langsung dan sering berjeda:
segments.tr: The mechanism is indirect and often delayed:

segments.src: 1. Harga komoditas turun, sehingga pendapatan dan laba perusahaan menurun.
segments.tr: 1. Commodity prices fall, so company revenue and profits decline.

segments.src: 2. Angsuran PPh Badan pada tahun berjalan dan pembayaran saat pelaporan tahunan ikut turun.
segments.tr: 2. Corporate income tax installments in the current year and payments at annual reporting fall as well.

segments.src: 3. Pajak yang terkait ekspor, impor, dan royalti juga ikut terdampak.
segments.tr: 3. Taxes related to exports, imports, and royalties are also affected.

segments.src: Karena ada jeda waktu, efek penurunan harga kadang baru terlihat pada penerimaan beberapa bulan atau bahkan satu tahun kemudian.
segments.tr: Because of the time lag, the effect of a price decline sometimes only shows up in revenue a few months or even a year later.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, kenaikan harga tidak otomatis langsung berubah menjadi lonjakan setoran.
segments.tr: Conversely, a price increase does not automatically translate into an immediate surge in payments.

segments.src: ## Coretax: harapan dan tantangan adaptasi
segments.tr: ## Coretax: hopes and adaptation challenges

segments.src: Coretax adalah sistem inti administrasi perpajakan yang dirancang mengintegrasikan pendaftaran, pelaporan, pembayaran, dan pengawasan dalam satu platform.
segments.tr: Coretax is the core tax administration system designed to integrate registration, reporting, payment, and oversight in one platform.

segments.src: Tujuan jangka panjangnya adalah meningkatkan kepatuhan, memperbaiki kualitas data, dan membuat administrasi lebih efisien.
segments.tr: Its long-term goals are to improve compliance, improve data quality, and make administration more efficient.

segments.src: Namun, pergantian sistem sebesar ini hampir selalu membawa masa transisi.
segments.tr: However, a system change of this scale almost always comes with a transition period.

segments.src: Beberapa tantangan yang kerap dibahas:
segments.tr: Some challenges that are often discussed:

segments.src: - **Penyesuaian wajib pajak dan pelaku usaha**, termasuk pada penerbitan faktur pajak dan pelaporan.
segments.tr: - **Adjustments for taxpayers and business operators**, including the issuance of tax invoices and reporting.

segments.src: - **Kendala teknis** pada masa awal penerapan yang dapat menunda pelaporan atau pembayaran.
segments.tr: - **Technical obstacles** in the early stages of implementation that can delay reporting or payments.

segments.src: - **Kurva belajar petugas pajak** dalam memanfaatkan data yang lebih terintegrasi untuk pengawasan.
segments.tr: - **The learning curve for tax officers** in using more integrated data for oversight.

segments.src: Dalam jangka menengah, sistem yang matang berpotensi memperkuat basis data dan pengawasan.
segments.tr: In the medium term, a mature system has the potential to strengthen the data base and oversight.

segments.src: Meski begitu, dampaknya pada angka penerimaan tidak instan dan sulit dipisahkan dari faktor ekonomi lain.
segments.tr: Even so, its effect on revenue figures is not immediate and is hard to separate from other economic factors.

segments.src: ## Mengapa target terasa sulit dikejar
segments.tr: ## Why targets feel hard to reach

segments.src: Beberapa faktor biasanya bekerja bersamaan:
segments.tr: Several factors usually work together:

segments.src: - **Target yang ambisius.** Target dalam APBN disusun dengan asumsi pertumbuhan ekonomi, harga komoditas, kurs, dan kepatuhan tertentu. Jika salah satu asumsi meleset, jarak ke target melebar.
segments.tr: - **Ambitious targets.** Targets in the APBN are set based on assumptions about economic growth, commodity prices, the exchange rate, and certain compliance levels. If one of these assumptions misses, the gap to the target widens.

segments.src: - **Basis pajak yang masih sempit.** Sebagian besar aktivitas ekonomi informal sulit dijangkau, sehingga rasio pajak terhadap PDB relatif rendah dibanding banyak negara sejenis.
segments.tr: - **A narrow tax base.** Much of the informal economy is hard to reach, so the tax-to-GDP ratio is relatively low compared with many similar countries.

segments.src: - **Insentif dan fasilitas pajak.** Keringanan untuk mendorong investasi dan daya beli mengurangi penerimaan dalam jangka pendek, meskipun dimaksudkan untuk manfaat yang lebih luas.
segments.tr: - **Incentives and tax facilities.** Relief intended to encourage investment and purchasing power reduces revenue in the short term, even though it is meant to benefit more people in the long run.

segments.src: - **Restitusi dan pergeseran waktu pembayaran.** Keduanya dapat membuat penerimaan neto per bulan berfluktuasi.
segments.tr: - **Refunds and shifts in payment timing.** Both can make monthly net revenue fluctuate.

segments.src: - **Perlambatan sektor tertentu.** Industri yang melemah memberi setoran lebih kecil.
segments.tr: - **Slowdown in certain sectors.** A weakening industry produces smaller payments.

segments.src: ## Dampak pada defisit dan belanja negara
segments.tr: ## Impact on the deficit and state spending

segments.src: Ketika penerimaan pajak tidak sejalan dengan rencana, pemerintah memiliki beberapa pilihan, yang masing-masing punya konsekuensi:
segments.tr: When tax revenue does not match the plan, the government has several options, each with its own consequences:

segments.src: 1. **Menerima defisit yang lebih lebar.** Defisit APBN dibatasi undang-undang maksimal 3 persen terhadap PDB, sehingga ruang geraknya terbatas.
segments.tr: 1. **Accept a wider deficit.** The APBN deficit is limited by law to a maximum of 3 percent of GDP, so the room to maneuver is limited.

segments.src: 2. **Menambah pembiayaan melalui utang.** Ini memperbesar beban bunga pada tahun-tahun berikutnya.
segments.tr: 2. **Add financing through debt.** This increases the interest burden in the following years.

segments.src: 3. **Menyesuaikan belanja.** Pos yang tidak mengikat, seperti sebagian belanja barang atau efisiensi anggaran, lebih mudah dikurangi dibanding subsidi dan gaji.
segments.tr: 3. **Adjust spending.** Items that are not binding, such as part of goods spending or budget efficiency measures, are easier to cut than subsidies and salaries.

segments.src: 4. **Mengoptimalkan sumber lain.** Misalnya PNBP, saldo anggaran lebih, atau penguatan intensifikasi pajak.
segments.tr: 4. **Optimize other sources.** For example PNBP, the budget surplus carryover, or strengthening tax intensification.

segments.src: Dengan belanja subsidi energi dan program prioritas yang besar, tekanan terhadap ruang fiskal menjadi lebih nyata.
segments.tr: With large energy subsidies and priority programs, pressure on fiscal space becomes more visible.

segments.src: Program yang berskala luas membutuhkan pembiayaan yang konsisten, sehingga disiplin menjaga defisit dan kredibilitas fiskal menjadi sorotan pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: Programs of large scale need consistent financing, so discipline in keeping the deficit in check and fiscal credibility become a focus for market participants.

segments.src: ## Apa yang perlu dicermati ke depan
segments.tr: ## What to watch going forward

segments.src: - **Laporan APBN KiTa bulanan**, terutama pemisahan penerimaan bruto dan neto serta rincian per jenis pajak.
segments.tr: - **Monthly APBN KiTa reports**, especially the separation of gross and net revenue and the breakdown by tax type.

segments.src: - **Pergerakan harga komoditas dan kurs**, karena memengaruhi PPh Badan dan pajak internasional.
segments.tr: - **Commodity price and exchange rate movements**, since they affect corporate income tax and international taxes.

segments.src: - **Perkembangan Coretax**, apakah transisi makin lancar dan kepatuhan membaik.
segments.tr: - **Coretax developments**, whether the transition is getting smoother and compliance is improving.

segments.src: - **Outlook akhir tahun** dari pemerintah, yang biasanya memperbarui perkiraan realisasi dan defisit.
segments.tr: - **The year-end outlook** from the government, which usually updates the estimates for realized revenue and the deficit.

segments.src: - **Arah kebijakan perpajakan**, termasuk perluasan basis pajak dan evaluasi insentif.
segments.tr: - **Direction of tax policy**, including expansion of the tax base and evaluation of incentives.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Sulitnya mengejar target pajak bukan disebabkan satu faktor tunggal.
segments.tr: The difficulty of chasing tax targets is not caused by a single factor.

segments.src: Kombinasi target yang tinggi, tekanan harga komoditas, restitusi, serta masa adaptasi sistem baru membentuk tantangan yang saling berkaitan.
segments.tr: A combination of high targets, commodity price pressure, refunds, and the adjustment period of a new system forms challenges that are interconnected.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, isu ini penting karena menyangkut kemampuan negara membiayai layanan publik dan program yang dirasakan langsung.
segments.tr: For the public, this issue matters because it concerns the state's ability to finance public services and programs that people feel directly.

segments.src: Memahami struktur penerimaan pajak membantu kita membaca berita fiskal secara lebih tenang dan kritis, tanpa terjebak pada satu angka saja.
segments.tr: Understanding the structure of tax revenue helps us read fiscal news more calmly and critically, without fixating on a single number.

segments.tr: *The information in this article is general and educational.

segments.tr: For the latest data, refer to the official publications of the Ministry of Finance and DJP.*

id-20261019-news-3.title: Rice and Chili Prices Ahead of Nataru: How to Read Bulog Stock, Harvest Supply, and the Risk of Price Increases

segments.src: Menjelang Natal dan Tahun Baru (Nataru), kabar tentang harga pangan hampir selalu ramai.
segments.tr: Ahead of Christmas and New Year (Nataru), news about food prices is almost always busy.

segments.src: Satu unggahan yang menyebut "harga cabai naik" bisa memicu belanja panik, padahal belum tentu pasokan benar-benar bermasalah.
segments.tr: A single post saying "chili prices are rising" can trigger panic buying, even though supply is not necessarily in trouble.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu Anda membaca situasi dengan lebih tenang: apa yang perlu dipantau, dari mana datanya, dan bagaimana membedakan kenaikan harga yang wajar dari kabar yang berlebihan.
segments.tr: This article helps you read the situation more calmly: what to monitor, where the data comes from, and how to distinguish a reasonable price increase from exaggerated news.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat edukatif dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau jaminan arah harga. Angka dan kondisi pasar dapat berubah dari hari ke hari, sehingga selalu rujuk data resmi terbaru.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is educational and is not financial advice or a guarantee of price direction. Figures and market conditions can change from day to day, so always refer to the latest official data.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga Pangan Cenderung Bergerak di Akhir Tahun
segments.tr: ## Why Food Prices Tend to Move at Year-End

segments.src: Ada beberapa faktor yang secara umum memengaruhi harga menjelang Nataru:
segments.tr: Several factors generally affect prices ahead of Nataru:

segments.src: - **Permintaan musiman.** Rumah tangga, restoran, katering, dan pelaku usaha kecil biasanya menambah pembelian untuk perayaan dan acara keluarga.
segments.tr: - **Seasonal demand.** Households, restaurants, catering businesses, and small business owners usually increase purchases for celebrations and family events.

segments.src: - **Cuaca.** Musim hujan dapat mengganggu panen, pengeringan gabah, dan distribusi. Pada cabai, curah hujan tinggi dapat memicu penyakit tanaman dan membuat hasil panen turun.
segments.tr: - **Weather.** The rainy season can disrupt harvests, grain drying, and distribution. For chili, heavy rainfall can trigger plant diseases and lower yields.

segments.src: - **Distribusi dan logistik.** Jalan rusak, cuaca buruk di laut, atau keterbatasan armada dapat menaikkan biaya angkut dan membuat pasokan antardaerah tidak merata.
segments.tr: - **Distribution and logistics.** Damaged roads, bad weather at sea, or limited fleet capacity can raise shipping costs and cause uneven supply between regions.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar rupiah.** Rupiah yang melemah dapat memengaruhi harga input pertanian yang bergantung pada impor, seperti sebagian pupuk, pestisida, dan pakan, serta komoditas pangan yang diimpor. Dampaknya biasanya bertahap, bukan seketika.
segments.tr: - **Exchange rate.** A weakening rupiah can affect the prices of agricultural inputs that rely on imports, such as some fertilizers, pesticides, and feed, as well as imported food commodities. The impact is usually gradual rather than immediate.

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi dan informasi.** Kabar yang beredar luas dapat membuat pedagang menahan stok dan pembeli memborong. Perilaku ini sendiri bisa mendorong harga naik.
segments.tr: - **Expectations and information.** Widely circulated news can lead traders to hold back stock and buyers to stock up. This behavior itself can push prices up.

segments.src: Penting diingat bahwa faktor-faktor ini tidak selalu muncul bersamaan, dan besar pengaruhnya berbeda-beda antar komoditas dan antar daerah.
segments.tr: It is important to remember that these factors do not always occur together, and their influence varies across commodities and regions.

segments.src: ## Membaca Stok Cadangan Beras Pemerintah
segments.tr: ## Reading Government Rice Reserve Stock

segments.src: Beras adalah komoditas dengan peran strategis, sehingga stok cadangannya sering dijadikan indikator ketenangan pasar.
segments.tr: Rice is a strategic commodity, so its reserve stock is often used as an indicator of market stability.

segments.src: Cara membacanya:
segments.tr: How to read it:

segments.src: 1. **Lihat jumlah stok, tetapi juga konteksnya.** Angka stok yang disampaikan Perum Bulog atau Badan Pangan Nasional lebih bermakna bila dibandingkan dengan kebutuhan bulanan dan kebutuhan penyaluran program, misalnya bantuan pangan dan stabilisasi pasokan dan harga (SPHP).
segments.tr: 1. **Look at the stock volume, but also its context.** Stock figures announced by Perum Bulog or the National Food Agency are more meaningful when compared with monthly needs and distribution requirements, such as food assistance and supply and price stabilization (SPHP) programs.

segments.src: 2. **Perhatikan sumber stok.** Stok dapat berasal dari penyerapan produksi dalam negeri maupun impor. Komposisi ini memberi gambaran seberapa bergantung pasokan pada faktor eksternal.
segments.tr: 2. **Check the source of stock.** Stock may come from domestic production absorption or from imports. This composition shows how dependent supply is on external factors.

segments.src: 3. **Pahami "ketahanan" stok.** Pertanyaannya bukan hanya "berapa juta ton", tetapi "cukup untuk berapa bulan penyaluran". Penjelasan resmi biasanya menyebut hal ini.
segments.tr: 3. **Understand the "resilience" of stock.** The question is not only "how many million tons", but "enough for how many months of distribution". Official explanations usually mention this.

segments.src: 4. **Bandingkan dengan harga di pasar.** Jika stok dilaporkan aman tetapi harga eceran tetap jauh di atas harga acuan, kemungkinan ada hambatan distribusi, bukan kekurangan stok semata.
segments.tr: 4. **Compare with market prices.** If stock is reported as safe but retail prices remain well above the reference price, there may be distribution bottlenecks rather than a simple shortage of stock.

segments.src: 5. **Perhatikan kualitas dan jenis.** Beras medium, premium, dan beras SPHP memiliki segmen dan harga berbeda. Kenaikan di satu jenis belum tentu berlaku untuk semua.
segments.tr: 5. **Pay attention to quality and type.** Medium rice, premium rice, and SPHP rice have different segments and prices. An increase in one type does not necessarily apply to all.

segments.src: ## Membaca Pasokan Panen
segments.tr: ## Reading Harvest Supply

segments.src: Stok cadangan hanyalah satu bagian.
segments.tr: Reserve stock is only one part.

segments.src: Pasokan dari panen sering menjadi penentu arah harga beberapa bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: Harvest supply often determines the direction of prices several months ahead.

segments.src: - **Kalender panen.** Panen raya padi biasanya terjadi pada awal tahun, sementara akhir tahun cenderung masuk masa tanam atau panen gadu. Pasokan gabah baru pada periode ini umumnya lebih terbatas.
segments.tr: - **Harvest calendar.** The main rice harvest usually occurs at the beginning of the year, while late in the year tends to fall into the planting season or the gadu (dry-season) harvest. New grain supply in this period is generally more limited.

segments.src: - **Harga gabah di tingkat petani.** Kenaikan harga gabah kering panen sering menjadi sinyal awal sebelum harga beras di pasar ikut bergerak.
segments.tr: - **Farm-gate grain prices.** Increases in the price of dry harvested grain (GKP) often serve as an early signal before rice prices in the market move.

segments.src: - **Informasi cuaca.** Pantau prakiraan musim dari BMKG. Anomali curah hujan dapat memengaruhi masa tanam dan hasil panen.
segments.tr: - **Weather information.** Monitor seasonal forecasts from BMKG. Rainfall anomalies can affect planting and harvest yields.

segments.src: - **Laporan daerah sentra.** Untuk beras, perhatikan kondisi di sentra seperti sebagian wilayah Jawa dan Sulawesi. Untuk cabai, perhatikan sentra hortikultura di daerah masing-masing.
segments.tr: - **Reports from production centers.** For rice, watch conditions in production centers such as parts of Java and Sulawesi. For chili, watch horticulture centers in your own region.

segments.src: ## Membaca Pasokan Cabai dan Hortikultura
segments.tr: ## Reading Chili and Horticulture Supply

segments.src: Cabai, bawang merah, dan tomat sifatnya mudah rusak dan tidak bisa disimpan lama.
segments.tr: Chili, shallots, and tomatoes are perishable and cannot be stored for long.

segments.src: Karena itu harganya jauh lebih fluktuatif dibanding beras.
segments.tr: That is why their prices fluctuate much more than rice.

segments.src: - **Pasokan harian ke pasar induk.** Jumlah kiriman ke pasar induk adalah indikator cepat. Penurunan pasokan beberapa hari berturut-turut biasanya lebih berarti daripada lonjakan satu hari.
segments.tr: - **Daily supply to wholesale markets.** The volume of shipments to central markets (pasar induk) is a quick indicator. A drop in supply over several consecutive days usually means more than a one-day spike.

segments.src: - **Harga di tingkat petani versus konsumen.** Selisih yang melebar bisa menunjukkan masalah rantai distribusi, bukan semata kelangkaan.
segments.tr: - **Farm-level versus consumer prices.** A widening gap may indicate problems in the distribution chain rather than scarcity alone.

segments.src: - **Dampak cuaca.** Hujan berkepanjangan dapat menurunkan panen dan kualitas cabai, sementara kemarau ekstrem juga memengaruhi produktivitas.
segments.tr: - **Weather impact.** Prolonged rain can reduce harvests and chili quality, while extreme dry seasons also affect productivity.

segments.src: - **Jenis cabai.** Cabai rawit merah, cabai merah keriting, dan cabai merah besar punya pola harga yang tidak selalu sama. Cek jenis yang Anda butuhkan.
segments.tr: - **Chili types.** Red bird's eye chili (cabai rawit merah), curly red chili (cabai merah keriting), and large red chili (cabai merah besar) do not always follow the same price patterns. Check the type you need.

segments.src: ## Memahami Operasi Pasar dan Intervensi Harga
segments.tr: ## Understanding Market Operations and Price Interventions

segments.src: Pemerintah pusat dan daerah, bersama BUMN pangan, kerap melakukan langkah stabilisasi menjelang hari besar, antara lain:
segments.tr: The central and regional governments, together with food SOEs, often carry out stabilization measures ahead of major holidays, including:

segments.src: - **Operasi pasar atau pasar murah** yang menyalurkan komoditas pada harga lebih terjangkau.
segments.tr: - **Market operations or cheap markets (pasar murah)** that distribute commodities at more affordable prices.

segments.src: - **Penyaluran beras SPHP** untuk menjaga harga dan pasokan di pasar.
segments.tr: - **Distribution of SPHP rice** to keep prices and supply stable in the market.

segments.src: - **Gerakan pangan murah** di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: - **Affordable food movements (gerakan pangan murah)** in various regions.

segments.src: - **Fasilitasi distribusi** dari daerah surplus ke daerah defisit.
segments.tr: - **Facilitation of distribution** from surplus regions to deficit regions.

segments.src: Cara menilainya secara kritis: tanyakan apakah operasi pasar berlangsung di wilayah Anda, berapa volume yang disalurkan, dan apakah harga di pasar sekitar ikut mereda setelahnya.
segments.tr: To assess these critically: ask whether market operations are taking place in your area, what volume is being distributed, and whether prices in nearby markets ease afterward.

segments.src: Intervensi biasanya meredam lonjakan, tetapi efeknya bergantung pada skala dan ketepatan sasaran.
segments.tr: Interventions usually dampen spikes, but their effect depends on scale and targeting accuracy.

segments.src: ## Sumber Data yang Layak Dipantau
segments.tr: ## Reliable Data Sources to Monitor

segments.src: Agar tidak sekadar mengikuti kabar di media sosial atau grup pesan, gunakan sumber resmi:
segments.tr: To avoid simply following news on social media or messaging groups, use official sources:

segments.src: - **Panel Harga Badan Pangan Nasional** untuk harga dan neraca pangan.
segments.tr: - **National Food Agency Price Panel** for prices and food balance.

segments.src: - **PIHPS Nasional (Bank Indonesia)** untuk harga pangan strategis harian di pasar tradisional.
segments.tr: - **National PIHPS (Bank Indonesia)** for daily prices of strategic foods in traditional markets.

segments.src: - **Situs dan kanal resmi Perum Bulog** untuk informasi stok dan penyaluran.
segments.tr: - **Official websites and channels of Perum Bulog** for stock and distribution information.

segments.src: - **BMKG** untuk prakiraan cuaca dan musim.
segments.tr: - **BMKG** for weather and seasonal forecasts.

segments.src: - **Dinas pertanian dan dinas perdagangan setempat** untuk kondisi di daerah Anda.
segments.tr: - **Local agriculture and trade offices** for conditions in your area.

segments.src: - **Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS)** untuk data inflasi dan perkembangan harga.
segments.tr: - **Statistics Indonesia (BPS)** for inflation data and price developments.

segments.src: Biasakan membandingkan minimal dua sumber sebelum menyimpulkan bahwa harga akan naik tajam.
segments.tr: Make a habit of comparing at least two sources before concluding that prices will rise sharply.

segments.src: ## Cara Memeriksa Kabar Harga Naik
segments.tr: ## How to Check Price Increase News

segments.src: Sebelum ikut membagikan atau bereaksi terhadap kabar harga, ajukan beberapa pertanyaan sederhana:
segments.tr: Before sharing or reacting to price news, ask a few simple questions:

segments.src: 1. **Siapa sumbernya?** Apakah berasal dari lembaga resmi, media yang kredibel, atau pesan berantai tanpa rujukan?
segments.tr: 1. **Who is the source?** Is it from an official institution, a credible media outlet, or a chain message without references?

segments.src: 2. **Kapan datanya?** Harga pangan bisa berubah cepat, jadi data minggu lalu belum tentu relevan.
segments.tr: 2. **When was the data collected?** Food prices can change quickly, so last week's data may not be relevant.

segments.src: 3. **Di daerah mana?** Harga di satu kota tidak otomatis mewakili daerah lain.
segments.tr: 3. **Which region?** A price in one city does not automatically represent other regions.

segments.src: 4. **Berapa besar perubahannya?** Kenaikan beberapa persen berbeda artinya dengan lonjakan dua kali lipat.
segments.tr: 4. **How large is the change?** A rise of a few percent means something different from a doubling.

segments.src: 5. **Apakah ada penjelasan penyebabnya?** Kabar yang baik biasanya menjelaskan faktor di baliknya, seperti pasokan, cuaca, atau distribusi.
segments.tr: 5. **Is there an explanation for the cause?** Good reporting usually explains the underlying factors, such as supply, weather, or distribution.

segments.src: ## Tips Praktis bagi Konsumen
segments.tr: ## Practical Tips for Consumers

segments.src: - **Belanja sesuai kebutuhan.** Membeli berlebihan hanya akan memperbesar tekanan pada harga dan berisiko menyisakan bahan yang terbuang.
segments.tr: - **Buy according to need.** Buying excessively only adds pressure on prices and risks leftover ingredients being wasted.

segments.src: - **Rencanakan menu.** Bila cabai mahal, pertimbangkan mengurangi porsi, memakai cabai kering atau olahan, atau mengganti sebagian dengan bumbu lain.
segments.tr: - **Plan your menu.** When chili is expensive, consider reducing portions, using dried or processed chili, or replacing part of it with other spices.

segments.src: - **Bandingkan beberapa tempat.** Pasar tradisional, pasar modern, dan penjual daring bisa menawarkan harga berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Compare several places.** Traditional markets, modern markets, and online sellers may offer different prices.

segments.src: - **Manfaatkan pasar murah resmi.** Cek jadwal di kelurahan atau dinas setempat.
segments.tr: - **Take advantage of official cheap markets.** Check the schedule at your village ward office (kelurahan) or local agency.

segments.src: - **Simpan dengan benar.** Cabai yang disimpan kering dan dingin lebih awet. Beras sebaiknya disimpan di wadah tertutup rapat.
segments.tr: - **Store properly.** Chili stored dry and cool lasts longer. Rice should be kept in a tightly sealed container.

segments.src: - **Siapkan anggaran fleksibel.** Sisihkan sedikit ruang untuk kenaikan harga yang wajar di akhir tahun.
segments.tr: - **Prepare a flexible budget.** Set aside a little room for reasonable price increases at year-end.

segments.src: ## Catatan untuk Pelaku Usaha Kecil
segments.tr: ## Notes for Small Business Owners

segments.src: Pemilik warung, katering, dan usaha kuliner dapat menyiapkan diri dengan menghitung ulang harga pokok penjualan, menjaga hubungan dengan pemasok tetap, dan menyusun alternatif bahan.
segments.tr: Stall owners, caterers, and culinary business operators can prepare by recalculating their cost of goods sold, maintaining good relationships with suppliers, and planning alternative ingredients.

segments.src: Bila harus menaikkan harga jual, lakukan secara bertahap dan jelaskan kepada pelanggan dengan jujur.
segments.tr: If they must raise selling prices, do so gradually and explain honestly to customers.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Kenaikan harga menjelang Nataru adalah pola yang sering muncul, tetapi besar dan lamanya bergantung pada kombinasi permintaan, cuaca, distribusi, dan kondisi ekonomi.
segments.tr: Price increases ahead of Nataru are a recurring pattern, but their size and duration depend on a combination of demand, weather, distribution, and economic conditions.

segments.src: Dengan membaca stok cadangan beras, pasokan panen, kiriman hortikultura ke pasar, serta langkah operasi pasar, Anda bisa menilai situasi berdasarkan data, bukan sekadar desas-desus.
segments.tr: By reading rice reserve stock, harvest supply, horticulture shipments to markets, and market operations, you can assess the situation based on data rather than mere rumors.

segments.src: Pantau sumber resmi, bandingkan informasi, dan belanja secara bijak.
segments.tr: Follow official sources, compare information, and shop wisely.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, Anda ikut menjaga ketenangan pasar sekaligus melindungi anggaran keluarga.
segments.tr: In this way, you help keep the market calm while protecting your family's budget.

segments.src: *Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan edukatif.
segments.tr: *The information in this article is general and educational.

segments.src: Untuk data harga dan stok terkini, silakan merujuk langsung ke lembaga resmi yang disebutkan di atas.*
segments.tr: For current price and stock data, please refer directly to the official institutions mentioned above.*

id-20261019-news-1.title: Start of the 2026 Rainy Season: Why the Transitional Season Is Prone to Flash Floods and Landslides, and the Preparations Residents Can Make

segments.src: Setelah berbulan-bulan kering, sebagian wilayah Indonesia mulai memasuki masa peralihan menuju musim hujan.
segments.tr: After months of dryness, parts of Indonesia are starting to enter the transition toward the rainy season.

segments.src: Pada fase ini, badan cuaca nasional, Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG), memantau tanda-tanda masuknya musim hujan di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: During this phase, the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) monitors signs of the rainy season arriving in various regions.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, informasi tersebut bukan sekadar kabar cuaca, melainkan petunjuk kapan perlu mulai bersiap.
segments.tr: For the public, this information is more than weather news. It is a signal of when to start preparing.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara membaca prakiraan musim hujan, alasan masa peralihan sering memicu bencana hidrometeorologi, daerah yang umumnya lebih rentan, serta langkah sederhana yang dapat dilakukan rumah tangga dan pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: This article explains how to read the rainy season forecast, why the transitional season often triggers hydrometeorological disasters, which areas are generally more vulnerable, and simple steps that households and local governments can take.

segments.src: Isinya bersifat informatif umum.
segments.tr: The content is general information only.

segments.src: Untuk data terbaru di wilayah Anda, rujuklah selalu pengumuman resmi BMKG dan pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: For the latest data in your area, always refer to official announcements from BMKG and your local government.

segments.src: ## Memahami Peralihan Musim
segments.tr: ## Understanding the Seasonal Transition

segments.src: Indonesia berada di wilayah tropis dengan dua musim utama, yaitu kemarau dan hujan.
segments.tr: Indonesia lies in the tropics and has two main seasons: the dry season and the rainy season.

segments.src: Di antara keduanya ada masa pancaroba atau peralihan, yang biasanya ditandai oleh:
segments.tr: In between is the transitional season (pancaroba), which is usually marked by:

segments.src: - Suhu siang hari terasa panas dan lembap.
segments.tr: - Daytime temperatures that feel hot and humid.

segments.src: - Awan konvektif tumbuh cepat pada siang hingga sore hari.
segments.tr: - Convective clouds that grow quickly from midday to afternoon.

segments.src: - Hujan lebat berdurasi singkat, kadang disertai petir dan angin kencang.
segments.tr: - Short, heavy rain, sometimes accompanied by lightning and strong winds.

segments.src: - Pola hujan yang belum stabil, sehingga hari cerah dan hari hujan bisa berganti dengan cepat.
segments.tr: - Unstable rainfall patterns, so sunny days and rainy days can alternate quickly.

segments.src: Awal musim hujan tidak terjadi serentak di seluruh negeri.
segments.tr: The start of the rainy season does not arrive at the same time across the country.

segments.src: Setiap wilayah memiliki waktu yang berbeda, bergantung pada letak geografis, pola angin, dan kondisi atmosfer serta laut di sekitarnya.
segments.tr: Each region has its own timing, depending on its geographic location, wind patterns, and the atmospheric and ocean conditions around it.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Masa Peralihan Rawan Banjir Bandang dan Longsor
segments.tr: ## Why the Transitional Season Is Prone to Flash Floods and Landslides

segments.src: Beberapa faktor membuat awal musim hujan memerlukan kewaspadaan khusus.
segments.tr: Several factors make the start of the rainy season require special vigilance.

segments.src: Tanah yang mengeras setelah kemarau.** Tanah kering dan retak menyerap air lebih lambat.
segments.tr: Soil hardens after the dry season.** Dry, cracked soil absorbs water more slowly.

segments.src: Hujan deras pertama dapat langsung mengalir di permukaan sehingga memicu genangan atau aliran cepat di sungai kecil.
segments.tr: The first heavy rains can run straight across the surface, causing puddles or fast flows in small rivers.

segments.src: Sampah dan sedimen menumpuk di saluran.** Selama kemarau, saluran air, gorong-gorong, dan sungai kecil sering terisi sampah, lumpur, dan ranting.
segments.tr: Garbage and sediment build up in drainage channels.** During the dry season, water channels, culverts, and small rivers often fill with trash, mud, and branches.

segments.src: Saat hujan lebat datang, aliran mudah tersumbat.
segments.tr: When heavy rain arrives, the flow easily becomes blocked.

segments.src: Lahan terbuka dan kerusakan vegetasi.** Lahan yang gundul, termasuk bekas kebakaran hutan dan lahan, memiliki daya serap dan penahan air yang lebih rendah.
segments.tr: Open land and damaged vegetation.** Bare land, including areas burned by forest and land fires, has a lower capacity to absorb and hold water.

segments.src: Di lereng, kondisi ini dapat meningkatkan risiko longsor.
segments.tr: On slopes, this condition can increase the risk of landslides.

segments.src: Hujan intens dalam waktu singkat.** Hujan dengan intensitas tinggi di hulu dapat membuat sungai meluap dengan cepat di hilir, bahkan ketika lokasi hilir tidak sedang hujan.
segments.tr: Intense rain in a short time.** High-intensity rain upstream can cause rivers to overflow quickly downstream, even when the downstream area is not raining.

segments.src: Inilah yang sering disebut banjir bandang.
segments.tr: This is what is often called a flash flood.

segments.src: Kesiapsiagaan yang belum optimal.** Karena sudah lama tidak ada hujan besar, banyak orang belum memeriksa kondisi lingkungan, jalur evakuasi, atau perlengkapan darurat.
segments.tr: Preparedness is not yet optimal.** Because there has been no major rain for a long time, many people have not checked their surroundings, evacuation routes, or emergency supplies.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Prakiraan Musim Hujan
segments.tr: ## How to Read the Rainy Season Forecast

segments.src: Prakiraan musim biasanya disampaikan dalam bentuk peta dan keterangan wilayah.
segments.tr: Seasonal forecasts are usually presented as maps and regional descriptions.

segments.src: Beberapa istilah yang sering muncul:
segments.tr: Some terms that often appear:

segments.src: - **Zona Musim (ZOM):** pembagian wilayah berdasarkan pola musim. Wilayah dalam satu zona memiliki karakter hujan yang relatif serupa.
segments.tr: - **Seasonal Zone (ZOM):** a division of regions based on seasonal patterns. Areas within one zone have relatively similar rainfall characteristics.

segments.src: - **Awal musim hujan:** ditentukan dari curah hujan yang mencapai ambang tertentu dalam periode sepuluh hari (dasarian) dan berlanjut pada dasarian berikutnya.
segments.tr: - **Start of the rainy season:** determined when rainfall reaches a certain threshold within a ten-day period (dasarian) and continues into the following dasarian.

segments.src: - **Sifat hujan:** dibandingkan dengan rata-rata jangka panjang, dikategorikan di bawah normal, normal, atau di atas normal.
segments.tr: - **Rainfall characteristics:** compared with the long-term average, categorized as below normal, normal, or above normal.

segments.src: - **Dasarian:** periode sepuluh hari, yaitu tiga periode dalam sebulan.
segments.tr: - **Dasarian:** a ten-day period. There are three dasarian in a month.

segments.src: Beberapa tips membacanya dengan benar:
segments.tr: Some tips for reading it correctly:

segments.src: 1. Cari informasi untuk wilayah Anda, bukan hanya angka nasional.
segments.tr: 1. Look for information for your area, not just national figures.

segments.src: 2. Perhatikan sifat hujan. Hujan di atas normal berarti peluang curah hujan tinggi lebih besar, sehingga kewaspadaan perlu ditingkatkan.
segments.tr: 2. Pay attention to rainfall characteristics. Above-normal rainfall means a greater chance of high rainfall totals, so vigilance should be raised.

segments.src: 3. Ingat bahwa prakiraan musim adalah gambaran umum. Untuk keputusan harian, gunakan prakiraan cuaca jangka pendek dan peringatan dini.
segments.tr: 3. Remember that a seasonal forecast is a general picture. For daily decisions, use short-term weather forecasts and early warnings.

segments.src: 4. Ikuti pembaruan, karena prakiraan dapat disesuaikan seiring perkembangan kondisi atmosfer.
segments.tr: 4. Follow updates, since forecasts may be adjusted as atmospheric conditions evolve.

segments.src: ## Daerah yang Umumnya Lebih Rentan
segments.tr: ## Areas That Are Generally More Vulnerable

segments.src: Tingkat kerentanan berbeda di setiap tempat.
segments.tr: Vulnerability differs from place to place.

segments.src: Secara umum, kawasan berikut perlu perhatian lebih:
segments.tr: In general, the following areas need extra attention:

segments.src: - **Bantaran sungai dan dataran rendah** yang rawan luapan.
segments.tr: - **Riverbanks and lowlands** prone to overflow.

segments.src: - **Kawasan perkotaan padat** dengan drainase terbatas dan sedikit area resapan.
segments.tr: - **Dense urban areas** with limited drainage and few absorption areas.

segments.src: - **Wilayah pesisir** yang dapat mengalami genangan ketika hujan lebat bertepatan dengan pasang laut.
segments.tr: - **Coastal areas** that can experience flooding when heavy rain coincides with high tide.

segments.src: - **Lereng perbukitan dan pegunungan**, terutama yang gundul, terpotong untuk permukiman, atau memiliki retakan tanah.
segments.tr: - **Hillsides and mountain slopes**, especially those that are bare, cut for settlements, or have ground cracks.

segments.src: - **Lembah dan alur sungai kecil di bawah daerah pegunungan**, yang berpotensi dilalui aliran deras mendadak.
segments.tr: - **Valleys and small river channels below mountainous areas**, which can be struck by sudden, fast-moving flows.

segments.src: Peta rawan bencana dari BNPB, BPBD, dan instansi terkait dapat membantu warga mengetahui tingkat risiko di lingkungannya.
segments.tr: Disaster-prone area maps from BNPB, BPBD, and related agencies can help residents understand the risk level in their neighborhood.

segments.src: ## Persiapan Sederhana untuk Rumah Tangga
segments.tr: ## Simple Preparations for Households

segments.src: Persiapan tidak harus mahal.
segments.tr: Preparation does not have to be expensive.

segments.src: Langkah berikut dapat dimulai sekarang:
segments.tr: The following steps can be started now:

segments.src: **Periksa lingkungan rumah**
segments.tr: **Check the home environment**

segments.src: - Bersihkan talang, selokan, dan saluran air di sekitar rumah.
segments.tr: - Clean gutters, drains, and water channels around the house.

segments.src: - Pangkas dahan pohon yang rapuh atau dekat dengan atap dan kabel listrik.
segments.tr: - Trim brittle branches or those close to the roof and power lines.

segments.src: - Periksa atap, genting, dan dinding dari kebocoran atau keretakan.
segments.tr: - Inspect the roof, tiles, and walls for leaks or cracks.

segments.src: - Jangan membuang sampah ke sungai atau saluran.
segments.tr: - Do not dump garbage into rivers or drainage channels.

segments.src: **Siapkan tas siaga**
segments.tr: **Prepare an emergency bag**

segments.src: - Dokumen penting dalam wadah kedap air, seperti kartu identitas, kartu keluarga, dan ijazah, serta salinan digitalnya.
segments.tr: - Important documents in a waterproof container, such as ID cards, family cards, and diplomas, plus digital copies.

segments.src: - Obat pribadi, perlengkapan P3K, dan masker.
segments.tr: - Personal medication, a first-aid kit, and masks.

segments.src: - Senter, baterai cadangan, power bank, dan radio kecil.
segments.tr: - Flashlight, spare batteries, a power bank, and a small radio.

segments.src: - Air minum, makanan siap saji, serta perlengkapan bayi atau lansia bila diperlukan.
segments.tr: - Drinking water, ready-to-eat food, and supplies for infants or the elderly if needed.

segments.src: - Uang tunai secukupnya dan daftar nomor kontak penting.
segments.tr: - Some cash and a list of important contact numbers.

segments.src: **Sepakati rencana keluarga**
segments.tr: **Agree on a family plan**

segments.src: - Tentukan titik kumpul dan jalur evakuasi yang aman.
segments.tr: - Set a meeting point and a safe evacuation route.

segments.src: - Pastikan semua anggota keluarga tahu cara mematikan listrik dan gas.
segments.tr: - Make sure every family member knows how to turn off electricity and gas.

segments.src: - Simpan nomor darurat setempat, seperti BPBD, puskesmas, dan aparat desa atau kelurahan.
segments.tr: - Save local emergency numbers, such as BPBD, the puskesmas (community health center), and village or urban ward officials.

segments.src: **Kenali tanda bahaya**
segments.tr: **Recognize warning signs**

segments.src: - Sungai tiba-tiba keruh, air naik cepat, atau terdengar gemuruh dari hulu.
segments.tr: - A river suddenly turns murky, water rises quickly, or a roaring sound is heard from upstream.

segments.src: - Muncul retakan baru di tanah atau dinding, pohon dan tiang miring, atau mata air tiba-tiba keruh di lereng.
segments.tr: - New cracks appear in the ground or walls, trees or poles lean, or a spring on a slope suddenly turns cloudy.

segments.src: - Hujan deras berlangsung lama, terutama di wilayah pegunungan.
segments.tr: - Heavy rain lasts a long time, especially in mountainous areas.

segments.src: Jika tanda-tanda itu muncul, jangan menunggu.
segments.tr: If these signs appear, do not wait.

segments.src: Segera menjauh dari sungai dan lereng, lalu ikuti arahan petugas.
segments.tr: Move away from rivers and slopes immediately, then follow the instructions of officials.

segments.src: ## Saat Hujan Lebat Terjadi
segments.tr: ## When Heavy Rain Occurs

segments.src: - Hindari menyeberangi arus air, meskipun tampak dangkal.
segments.tr: - Avoid crossing flowing water, even if it looks shallow.

segments.src: - Jauhi bawah pohon besar, baliho, dan tiang saat angin kencang atau petir.
segments.tr: - Stay away from large trees, billboards, and poles during strong winds or lightning.

segments.src: - Matikan listrik bila air mulai masuk ke rumah.
segments.tr: - Turn off electricity if water starts entering the house.

segments.src: - Jangan berteduh atau berkendara di bantaran sungai dan bawah tebing.
segments.tr: - Do not take shelter or drive along riverbanks or below cliffs.

segments.src: - Pantau informasi dari kanal resmi, bukan kabar berantai yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: - Follow official channels, not unverified chain messages.

segments.src: ## Peran Pemerintah Daerah dan Komunitas
segments.tr: ## The Role of Local Governments and Communities

segments.src: Kesiapsiagaan bukan hanya tanggung jawab individu.
segments.tr: Preparedness is not only the responsibility of individuals.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang lazim dan penting untuk pemerintah daerah serta komunitas:
segments.tr: Some common and important steps for local governments and communities:

segments.src: - **Normalisasi dan pembersihan** sungai, saluran, serta gorong-gorong sebelum puncak hujan.
segments.tr: - **Normalization and cleaning** of rivers, drainage channels, and culverts before the peak of the rainy season.

segments.src: - **Pemetaan dan pemantauan titik rawan**, termasuk lereng yang berpotensi longsor.
segments.tr: - **Mapping and monitoring of vulnerable points**, including slopes with potential for landslides.

segments.src: - **Penyebaran peringatan dini** melalui media sosial resmi, pengeras suara, dan jaringan RT/RW.
segments.tr: - **Dissemination of early warnings** through official social media, loudspeakers, and the RT/RW neighborhood network.

segments.src: - **Penyiapan posko, logistik, dan peralatan**, serta penyegaran koordinasi antarinstansi.
segments.tr: - **Preparing command posts, logistics, and equipment**, and refreshing coordination among agencies.

segments.src: - **Latihan evakuasi** bersama warga, sekolah, dan pelaku usaha setempat.
segments.tr: - **Evacuation drills** with residents, schools, and local businesses.

segments.src: - **Penataan ruang** yang menjaga daerah resapan, sempadan sungai, dan tutupan vegetasi di hulu.
segments.tr: - **Spatial planning** that protects absorption areas, river borders, and upstream vegetation cover.

segments.src: - **Kerja bakti rutin** agar kebersihan saluran menjadi kebiasaan bersama.
segments.tr: - **Routine community clean-up work** so that keeping drainage channels clean becomes a shared habit.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Masa peralihan menuju musim hujan adalah waktu terbaik untuk bersiap, bukan menunggu bencana datang.
segments.tr: The transitional season toward the rainy season is the best time to prepare, not to wait for disaster to arrive.

segments.src: Dengan memahami prakiraan musim, mengenali risiko di sekitar tempat tinggal, merapikan lingkungan, dan menyiapkan rencana keluarga, dampak banjir bandang dan longsor dapat ditekan.

id-20261019-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #1] Imported Goods Are More Than Their Factory Price: Getting to Know International Logistics

segments.src: > Logistik internasional adalah "jalan tol tak terlihat" yang memindahkan barang, informasi, dan dokumen lintas negara. Biayanya ikut menentukan apakah sebuah produk bisa bersaing di pasar dunia.
segments.tr: > International logistics is the "invisible toll road" that moves goods, information, and documents across countries. Its cost also determines whether a product can compete in the global market.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Coba lihat label di barang-barang di sekitar Anda: ponsel rakitan Tiongkok, susu dari Selandia Baru, sepatu buatan Vietnam.
segments.tr: Take a look at the labels on things around you: a phone assembled in China, milk from New Zealand, shoes made in Vietnam.

segments.src: Semua barang itu menempuh perjalanan panjang sebelum sampai ke tangan Anda.
segments.tr: All of these goods travel a long way before they reach your hands.

segments.src: Semua kegiatan yang mengatur perjalanan itu disebut **logistik internasional**.
segments.tr: All the activities that organize that journey are called **international logistics**.

segments.src: Secara sederhana, logistik internasional adalah kegiatan **merencanakan, menjalankan, dan mengendalikan aliran barang, informasi, dan uang** dari titik asal di satu negara ke titik tujuan di negara lain, supaya barang tiba **tepat waktu, dalam kondisi baik, dengan biaya wajar**.
segments.tr: Simply put, international logistics is the **planning, execution, and control of the flow of goods, information, and money** from an origin in one country to a destination in another, so that goods arrive **on time, in good condition, and at a reasonable cost**.

segments.src: Dibandingkan logistik domestik, logistik internasional punya tiga tantangan tambahan:
segments.tr: Compared with domestic logistics, international logistics has three additional challenges:

segments.src: - **Jarak lebih jauh** dan biasanya butuh lebih dari satu moda angkutan (truk → kapal → truk).
segments.tr: - **Greater distance**, usually requiring more than one mode of transport (truck → ship → truck).

segments.src: - **Batas negara**: ada bea cukai, aturan impor-ekspor, dan dokumen seperti *invoice*, *packing list*, dan *bill of lading*.
segments.tr: - **National borders**: customs, import-export regulations, and documents such as the *invoice*, *packing list*, and *bill of lading*.

segments.src: - **Perbedaan mata uang, bahasa, dan zona waktu.**
segments.tr: - **Differences in currency, language, and time zones.**

segments.src: **Fungsi utama logistik** bisa diringkas menjadi enam:
segments.tr: **The main functions of logistics** can be summarized into six:

segments.src: 1. **Transportasi**: memindahkan barang lewat laut, udara, darat, atau kombinasinya.
segments.tr: 1. **Transportation**: moving goods by sea, air, land, or a combination of these.

segments.src: 2. **Pergudangan**: menyimpan barang sementara sebelum dikirim atau dijual.
segments.tr: 2. **Warehousing**: storing goods temporarily before they are shipped or sold.

segments.src: 3. **Pengemasan**: melindungi barang dan memudahkan penanganan, misalnya dengan kontainer standar.
segments.tr: 3. **Packaging**: protecting goods and making them easier to handle, for example with standard containers.

segments.src: 4. **Penanganan muatan** (*cargo handling*): bongkar-muat di pelabuhan atau bandara.
segments.tr: 4. **Cargo handling**: loading and unloading at ports or airports.

segments.src: 5. **Kepabeanan dan dokumen**: mengurus izin agar barang boleh keluar dan masuk suatu negara.
segments.tr: 5. **Customs and documentation**: arranging permits so goods may leave and enter a country.

segments.src: 6. **Manajemen informasi**: melacak posisi barang dan mengoordinasikan semua pihak yang terlibat.
segments.tr: 6. **Information management**: tracking the location of goods and coordinating all the parties involved.

segments.src: **Struktur biaya logistik.** Biaya logistik bukan hanya ongkos kirim.
segments.tr: **Logistics cost structure.** Logistics costs are not just shipping fees.

segments.src: Komponennya biasanya:
segments.tr: The components usually are:

segments.src: - **Biaya transportasi**: sering kali porsi terbesar, termasuk ongkos angkut laut (*freight*) dan angkutan darat ke dan dari pelabuhan.
segments.tr: - **Transportation costs**: often the largest share, including sea freight and land transport to and from the port.

segments.src: - **Biaya persediaan**: modal yang "tertahan" selama barang masih di perjalanan atau di gudang, ditambah risiko barang rusak atau usang.
segments.tr: - **Inventory costs**: capital that is "tied up" while goods are in transit or in a warehouse, plus the risk of goods being damaged or becoming obsolete.

segments.src: - **Biaya pergudangan dan penanganan**: sewa gudang, bongkar-muat, biaya terminal.
segments.tr: - **Warehousing and handling costs**: warehouse rent, loading and unloading, terminal fees.

segments.src: - **Biaya administrasi**: dokumen, jasa *freight forwarder*, asuransi kargo.
segments.tr: - **Administrative costs**: documents, freight forwarder services, cargo insurance.

segments.src: Gambaran kasarnya seperti ini:
segments.tr: A rough picture looks like this:

segments.src: Total biaya logistik = transportasi + persediaan + pergudangan/penanganan + administrasi
segments.tr: Total biaya logistik = transportasi + persediaan + pergudangan/penanganan + administrasi

segments.src: Yang penting diingat, komponen-komponen ini saling tarik-menarik (*trade-off*).
segments.tr: The important thing to remember is that these components trade off against each other (*trade-off*).

segments.src: Kapal laut lebih murah daripada pesawat, tetapi jauh lebih lambat, sehingga biaya persediaan selama perjalanan naik.
segments.tr: Sea shipping is cheaper than air freight, but much slower, so inventory costs during transit go up.

segments.src: Logistik yang baik mencari **total biaya** terendah, bukan sekadar ongkos kirim termurah.
segments.tr: Good logistics aims for the **lowest total cost**, not merely the cheapest shipping fee.

segments.src: **Hubungan perdagangan dan logistik.** Perdagangan internasional menjawab pertanyaan "apa yang dijual dan ke mana".
segments.tr: **The relationship between trade and logistics.** International trade answers the question "what is sold, and where?"

segments.src: Logistik menjawab "bagaimana barang itu sampai ke sana".
segments.tr: Logistics answers "how do the goods get there?"

segments.src: Keduanya tidak bisa dipisahkan:
segments.tr: The two cannot be separated:

segments.src: - Kalau biaya logistik turun, harga produk ekspor di negara tujuan ikut turun, sehingga daya saingnya naik.
segments.tr: - If logistics costs fall, the price of exported products in the destination country falls too, so their competitiveness rises.

segments.src: - Kalau logistik lambat atau mahal, produk yang sebenarnya bagus bisa kalah bersaing.
segments.tr: - If logistics is slow or expensive, a product that is genuinely good can lose out in competition.

segments.src: - Itu sebabnya Bank Dunia menyusun **Logistics Performance Index (LPI)** untuk membandingkan kinerja logistik antarnegara, dan pemerintah banyak negara, termasuk Indonesia, menjadikan penurunan biaya logistik sebagai target kebijakan.
segments.tr: - That is why the World Bank compiles the **Logistics Performance Index (LPI)** to compare logistics performance across countries, and why many governments, including Indonesia's, treat lowering logistics costs as a policy target.

segments.src: ## Di Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Bu Sari, pemilik usaha mebel kayu jati di **Jepara**, mendapat pesanan meja makan dari pembeli di **Rotterdam, Belanda**.
segments.tr: Imagine Bu Sari, who owns a teak furniture business in **Jepara**, receives an order for a dining table from a buyer in **Rotterdam, the Netherlands**.

segments.src: Harga meja di pabriknya, misalnya, Rp5 juta per unit.
segments.tr: The table's price at her factory is, for example, Rp5 million per unit.

segments.src: Tetapi supaya meja itu sampai di Rotterdam, ada banyak langkah yang harus dilalui:
segments.tr: But for the table to reach Rotterdam, many steps must be completed:

segments.src: 1. Meja dikemas dengan kayu pelindung dan plastik agar tidak lembap selama berminggu-minggu di laut (**pengemasan**).
segments.tr: 1. The table is packed with protective wood and plastic so it does not get damp during weeks at sea (**packaging**).

segments.src: 2. Truk membawa kontainer dari Jepara ke **Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas, Semarang** (**transportasi darat**).
segments.tr: 2. A truck carries the container from Jepara to **Tanjung Emas Port, Semarang** (**land transportation**).

segments.src: 3. *Freight forwarder* mengurus dokumen ekspor dan pemeriksaan bea cukai (**kepabeanan dan dokumen**).
segments.tr: 3. A *freight forwarder* handles the export documents and customs inspection (**customs and documentation**).

segments.src: 4. Kontainer dimuat ke kapal, biasanya transit dulu di pelabuhan besar seperti Singapura, lalu berlayar ke Eropa selama beberapa minggu (**transportasi laut**).
segments.tr: 4. The container is loaded onto a ship, usually transshipped first at a major port such as Singapore, then sailed to Europe over several weeks (**sea transportation**).

segments.src: 5. Di Rotterdam, kontainer dibongkar, diperiksa bea cukai Belanda, lalu dikirim ke gudang pembeli (**penanganan muatan dan pergudangan**).
segments.tr: 5. In Rotterdam, the container is unloaded, inspected by Dutch customs, and delivered to the buyer's warehouse (**cargo handling and warehousing**).

segments.src: Setiap tahap menambah biaya.
segments.tr: Every stage adds cost.

segments.src: Bagi pembeli di Belanda, yang dibandingkan bukan harga di Jepara, melainkan **harga setelah meja tiba di gudangnya**.
segments.tr: For the buyer in the Netherlands, what is compared is not the price in Jepara but the **price after the table arrives at their warehouse**.

segments.src: Kalau pesaing dari negara lain bisa mengirim meja serupa dengan biaya logistik lebih rendah atau waktu lebih cepat, Bu Sari bisa kehilangan pesanan, meskipun mejanya lebih bagus.
segments.tr: If a competitor from another country can ship a similar table at lower logistics cost or faster, Bu Sari could lose the order, even though her table is better.

segments.src: Di sinilah terlihat bahwa logistik bukan sekadar urusan "kirim barang".
segments.tr: This shows that logistics is not merely a matter of "shipping goods."

segments.src: Logistik adalah bagian dari strategi bisnis.
segments.tr: Logistics is part of business strategy.

segments.src: Dalam praktik, siapa yang menanggung biaya pada tiap tahap biasanya disepakati lewat aturan standar bernama *Incoterms*, yang akan dibahas di seri berikutnya.
segments.tr: In practice, who bears the cost at each stage is usually agreed through standard rules called *Incoterms*, which will be discussed in the next series.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Logistik internasional mengatur aliran barang, informasi, dan uang lintas negara melalui fungsi transportasi, pergudangan, pengemasan, penanganan muatan, kepabeanan, dan informasi.
segments.tr: 1. International logistics manages the flow of goods, information, and money across countries through the functions of transportation, warehousing, packaging, cargo handling, customs, and information.

segments.src: 2. Biaya logistik terdiri atas transportasi, persediaan, pergudangan/penanganan, dan administrasi. Yang dicari adalah total biaya terendah, bukan ongkos kirim termurah saja.
segments.tr: 2. Logistics costs consist of transportation, inventory, warehousing/handling, and administration. The goal is the lowest total cost, not just the cheapest shipping fee.

segments.src: 3. Logistik yang efisien menurunkan harga akhir produk di negara tujuan, sehingga menjadi penentu penting daya saing perdagangan.
segments.tr: 3. Efficient logistics lowers the final price of products in the destination country, making it an important determinant of trade competitiveness.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Manakah yang **bukan** termasuk fungsi utama logistik internasional?
segments.tr: **1.** Which of the following is **not** a main function of international logistics?

segments.src: - A. Transportasi
segments.tr: - A. Transportation

segments.src: - B. Kepabeanan dan dokumen
segments.tr: - B. Customs and documentation

segments.src: - C. Desain logo produk
segments.tr: - C. Product logo design

segments.src: - D. Pergudangan
segments.tr: - D. Warehousing

segments.src: **2.** Benar atau Salah (B/S): Memilih moda angkutan dengan ongkos kirim termurah selalu menghasilkan total biaya logistik paling rendah.
segments.tr: **2.** True or False (T/F): Choosing the transport mode with the cheapest shipping fee always results in the lowest total logistics cost.

segments.src: **3.** Jika biaya logistik suatu negara turun secara signifikan, dampak yang paling mungkin terjadi adalah…
segments.tr: **3.** If a country's logistics costs fall significantly, the most likely effect is…

segments.src: - A. Produk ekspornya menjadi kurang kompetitif
segments.tr: - A. Its export products become less competitive

segments.src: - B. Harga produk ekspornya di negara tujuan cenderung lebih bersaing
segments.tr: - B. The price of its export products in the destination country tends to become more competitive

segments.src: - C. Kebutuhan dokumen ekspor otomatis hilang
segments.tr: - C. The need for export documents disappears automatically

segments.src: - D. Perdagangan internasionalnya pasti berhenti
segments.tr: - D. International trade will definitely stop

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Logistik internasional**: perencanaan dan pengendalian aliran barang, informasi, dan uang lintas batas negara.
segments.tr: - **International logistics**: the planning and control of the flow of goods, information, and money across national borders.

segments.src: - **Freight forwarder**: perusahaan jasa yang mengatur pengiriman dan dokumen atas nama pengirim barang.
segments.tr: - **Freight forwarder**: a service company that arranges shipments and documents on behalf of the shipper of goods.

segments.src: - **Bill of Lading (B/L)**: dokumen dari pengangkut laut yang menjadi tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak angkut, dan bukti kepemilikan atas barang.
segments.tr: - **Bill of Lading (B/L)**: a document issued by the sea carrier that serves as a receipt for goods, evidence of the contract of carriage, and evidence of ownership of the goods.

segments.src: - **Biaya persediaan**: biaya yang timbul karena barang disimpan atau masih dalam perjalanan, termasuk modal yang tertahan dan risiko kerusakan.
segments.tr: - **Inventory costs**: costs arising because goods are stored or still in transit, including tied-up capital and the risk of damage.

segments.src: - **Logistics Performance Index (LPI)**: indeks Bank Dunia yang membandingkan kinerja logistik antarnegara.
segments.tr: - **Logistics Performance Index (LPI)**: a World Bank index that compares logistics performance across countries.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1-C (desain logo adalah urusan pemasaran, bukan fungsi logistik).
segments.tr: *Answers: 1-C (logo design is a marketing matter, not a logistics function).

segments.src: 2-S (angkutan murah tetapi lambat bisa menaikkan biaya persediaan, jadi yang harus dihitung adalah total biaya).
segments.tr: 2-F (cheap but slow transport can raise inventory costs, so the total cost is what must be calculated).

segments.src: 3-B (biaya logistik yang lebih rendah membuat harga akhir di negara tujuan lebih kompetitif).*
segments.tr: 3-B (lower logistics costs make the final price in the destination country more competitive).*
